visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a person's hands holding a light blue or lavender-tinted Samsung S25 Ultra smartphone against a dark navy blue curtain backdrop. The triple-lens camera module is clearly visible on the back panel, catching the studio light. Yellow and white title text overlays appear at the top, while white subtitles with a black border are at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a macro close-up comparing the top corner of the S25 Ultra to an older model. The reviewer’s finger points at the newly rounded corner, highlighting the ergonomic shift from the previous sharp 90-degree angle. The lighting is bright and even, showcasing the metallic finish of the frame. (3) A split-screen visual comparison shows the front displays of the S25 Ultra and S24 Ultra. The bezels on the left side (S25) are visibly thinner than those on the right. Both screens show system interfaces with time and weather widgets. The reviewer’s finger taps the top punch-hole camera, which is significantly smaller on the new model. (4) The camera perspective shifts to the side profiles of both phones held side-by-side. The S25 Ultra is shown to have flat sides compared to the slight curvature of the S24 Ultra. The hands rotate the devices slowly to allow the viewer to see the port layout and button placement. (5) The screen switches back to a split-screen photo comparison. Vividly colored fruits (lemons, dragon fruit) and green leaves are used to demonstrate camera sharpness and detail enhancement between the two generations. (6) Finally, the reviewer holds the S25 Ultra alone, tilting it to show how the light reflects off the back glass, transitioning between purple and silver hues. Text overlays provide weight statistics comparing the various S25 models.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: S25 Ultra 新機搶先看!. [Subtitle]: 各位我們第一時間. (2) [Subtitle]: 最新一代的 S25 Ultra. (3) [Subtitle]: 手上這一支是太空藍. (4) [Subtitle]: 這次在外觀上最大的改動呢. (5) [Subtitle]: 就是真的給了一個圓角. (6) [Subtitle]: 上一代的 S24 Ultra 是 90 度角的. (7) [Subtitle]: 但老實講啊 這一個圓角. (8) [Subtitle]: 你如果拿 S25 Plus 相比的話. (9) [Subtitle]: 其實是比較不圓的. (10) [Logo]: S25 Ultra S24 Ultra. [Subtitle]: 這一代的邊框又更細了. (11) [Subtitle]: 我實際看呢 又比 24 Ultra 再更細. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且前置鏡頭這個孔 也稍微再挖細一點. (13) [Subtitle]: 外觀上我覺得 這一代也是蠻好看的. (14) [Subtitle]: 而且側面的握感 跟上一代的握感也不一樣. (15) [Subtitle]: 上一代稍微有一點點弧形. (16) [Subtitle]: 但這一代是平的. (17) [Subtitle]: 但老實講我比較喜歡上一代的握感. (18) [Subtitle]: 這個就很主觀. (19) [Subtitle]: 那這代在拍照上的改動呢. (20) [Subtitle]: 就是給了一個 5000 萬畫素的超廣角. (21) [Subtitle]: 那經過我實測 真的整個銳度跟細節. (22) [Subtitle]: 其實比 24 Ultra 好非常的多. (23) [Subtitle]: 第一時間呢 雖然說覺得它的長焦沒有改動. (24) [Subtitle]: 有點可惜 但是測完發現. (25) [Subtitle]: 它在 20 倍跟 100 倍的 AI 自動的算法. (26) [Subtitle]: 的銳度表現 也比 24 Ultra 好. (27) [Subtitle]: 所以在拍照上呢 主鏡頭還有長焦鏡頭. (28) [Subtitle]: 有改善一點點. (29) [Subtitle]: 然後超廣角呢 是改善非常的多. (30) [Slogan]: S25 Ultra 218g (-15g) S25 Plus 190g (-7g) S25 162g (-6g). [Subtitle]: 這次還有一大亮點. (31) [Subtitle]: 就是整體變輕了. (32) [Subtitle]: 它跟上一代相比 輕了整整 15 克. (33) [Subtitle]: 甚至也比 iPhone 16 Pro Max 還要更輕. (34) [Subtitle]: 最後給大家看一下新顏色.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator introduces the video with a high-arousal, energetic greeting in Traditional Chinese. Background music consists of an upbeat electronic synth track with a steady 124 BPM rhythm and strong bass kicks. The sound quality is studio-grade with high clarity. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition as the speaker points out physical design changes. The vocal delivery is fast-paced but clearly enunciated. (3) A subtle digital 'click' sound effect accompanies the visual highlight of the bezel comparison. The speaker's pitch rises slightly to emphasize his excitement about the thinner bezels. (4) Narration continues with high density, detailing technical specifications of the camera and weight. The BGM remains consistently layered underneath the vocals without masking them. (5) SFX representing digital shutter sounds or UI interactions are briefly heard during the photo review phase. (6) The speaker's tone becomes more evaluative and subjective as he compares the 'feel' of the two devices. The music maintains its energetic drive until the end of the clip.
